listing.name: The Order: 1886 — The-Order-1886-PC-Port (IgorAugustoHH)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream claims native Windows gameplay, original PS4 cinematic camera, DLSS, controls and in-game settings with 30/60/90/120FPS limits. Heavy-scene examples on i5-10400F/RTX2060/16GB report about45-50FPS with original TAA,40-45FPS DLSS Quality and up to80FPS DLSS Performance; the120FPS option is not a universal measured result. All chapters are still being tested. Known lighting flicker, black facial spots on some characters and one cutscene sync issue remain;1440p/4K unsupported. No complete playthrough or Portcove build/package/gameplay qualification is established. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS4 The Order: 1886 CUSA00785 base dump with owned update1.02 already merged (version01.02), including eboot.bin and original game files. TOport checks declared title/version and refuses others; exact executable/asset digests are not established by this README. Upstream says no original executable, data, shaders or extracted artwork are distributed; shader cache is generated locally.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream README advertises TOport-Windows.zip v0.1.3 prerelease via Releases. Extract, open TOport.exe, select the owned version01.02 folder containing eboot.bin and click Play. First start prepares the game and compiles shaders locally while playing; original files remain needed. Alternative Windows source build uses MSYS2 CLANG64, bash build.sh and bash packaging/windows/package_toport.sh. No ZIP was downloaded or inspected; this is a manual discovery route, not managed acquisition or runtime qualification.
